title: Close D&D SRD gameplay-modeling gaps from 2026-06-29 audit
description:
Follow-up epic from audit bundle dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle-062926.zip.

Audit summary:
- Generated pack is reproducible and source-complete at the current gate level.
- verify:dnd5e-srd-pack, check, typecheck, and test passed.
- Source coverage reported 2,258 inventory items and 0 unaccounted items.
- Source region ledger reported 0 unrepresented prose and 0 broad structural ignores.
- Pack contains 1,812 records across 16 kinds.
- No high-confidence record/source text corruption was found in this pass.

Remaining problem:
The importer is now healthy as a source-coverage milestone, but the pack is not yet gameplay-ready for deterministic character creation and tool-driven gameplay. Important gameplay choices and mechanics are still buried in prose rather than represented as addressable, queryable, and applicable data.

Scope:
- Add audit gates for unstructured choice-bearing prose.
- Model class/subclass option catalogs.
- Resolve starting equipment into deterministic item grants.
- Complete ancestry/background build choices.
- Add first-pass mechanics projections for spells, actions, features, hazards, and creatures.
- Clean up minor audit/reporting issues found in the 2026-06-29 bundle.

Non-goals:
- Do not re-run a broad source-accuracy importer rewrite unless a child bead finds concrete bad extraction.
- Do not build a full combat rules engine in one step.
- Do not use the LLM as source of truth; all modeled data must be derived deterministically from the vendored SRD source.
close_reason: All nine child beads completed and PR #373 merged to main; new audit bundle will be generated from merged main.
